tasks.notes: Runs the FreeAgent invoice collector from the Mac Studio runtime copy.

tasks.name: Octospark Temporal route health
tasks.notes: Checks host and Docker TCP reachability to the Temporal server (Hetzner temporal-server over Tailscale, from op://octospark-services/<env>/TEMPORAL_ADDRESS), repairs stale Tailscale routes, then restarts the staging worker container AND kickstarts both com.octospark.auto-fix-runner.{staging,prod} launchd agents after repair.

tasks.name: Trace Learn compose stack boot recovery
tasks.notes: Starts existing Trace Learn prod+staging containers after a reboot. Docker Desktop on macOS starts at user LOGIN not boot, so restart:always alone cannot help - a 2026-07-26 reboot left api.tracelearn.app on 502 for ~20h while tracelearn.app kept returning 200 from Cloudflare Pages. NOT a deploy: no build, pull, secrets or migrations, so it needs no op service account. Idempotent. Maintenance opt-out: touch state/trace-learn-stack-boot/disabled.

tasks.name: Octospark Sentry auto-fix Temporal workers (staging + prod)
tasks.notes: Two KeepAlive launchd agents (com.octospark.auto-fix-runner.staging and .prod) polling Temporal task queue auto-fix-octospark on the Hetzner temporal-server. Installed from the dedicated ~/octospark-autofix checkout by the octospark repo installer, which fast-forwards to origin/staging, rebuilds, and re-renders env from ~/.local/state/octospark/deploy/{staging,prod}.env. Health: Sentry Cron monitors auto-fix-runner-staging / auto-fix-runner-prod (missed check-in = worker down or not polling). Registered here for fleet visibility; install/update stays with the octospark repo script.
